contest.measure_text: San Marino Unified School District Quality Education Measure Without increasing the existing rates and to protect/maintain quality education programs, classroom instruction, prevent class size increases or teaching position reductions, attract/retain high-quality teachers/employees, support advanced programs in math, science, engineering, technology, shall San Marino Unified School District's measure to combine and renew their existing parcel taxes for 6 years at $1,499 (combined) with senior exemptions, raising approximately $6,100,000 annually, annual adjustments, requiring spending disclosure be adopted? Supporters: Mandy Saber, President, San Marino Council of PTAs; Karla Domier; Janice Lee; Paul Callahan; Dr. Peter Koh, OD Opponents: None submitted.
